methods.label: Recall the minute hand's full-turn time
methods.explanation: The minute hand takes 60 minutes, or 1 hour, to complete one full turn. It is the second hand that takes 60 seconds to complete one full turn.
methods.levelReason: Clock-hand durations and basic time-unit relationships are appropriate for Grade 3.
